userId.title: User ID
userId.description: Optional Laravel/backend account ID. Included in the webhook callback payload.

callbackUrl.title: Callback (webhook) URL
callbackUrl.description: Optional URL that receives a JSON POST with the result (success or failure).

webhookAuthToken.title: Webhook auth token
webhookAuthToken.description: Optional Bearer token sent in the Authorization header of the webhook callback.

twoCaptchaApiKey.title: 2Captcha API key
twoCaptchaApiKey.description: API key for the 2captcha service used to solve reCAPTCHA on checkout.

useApifyProxy.title: Use Apify residential proxy
useApifyProxy.description: Route the browser through Apify's residential proxy so IPTVV's Cloudflare sees a residential IP instead of the datacenter IP (which it blocks). Disable only to use a direct connection.

proxyCountry.title: Proxy country code
proxyCountry.description: ISO country code for the residential exit IP (the target site is iptvv.ca, so CA is the default). Leave empty for any country.

proxyGroups.title: Proxy groups
proxyGroups.description: Comma-separated Apify proxy groups. RESIDENTIAL is required to pass Cloudflare's datacenter-IP block.

emailBackend.title: Email backend
emailBackend.description: Which mailbox to use for receiving the credentials email. 'mailcx' uses api.mail.cx (requires an API token below); 'boomlify' uses boomlify.com's free web inbox (no key or captcha; add an API key below to use its paid API instead); 'tmaily' allocates a disposable tmaily.com inbox per run; 'gmail' uses a real Gmail inbox with a unique plus-addressed alias per run (best deliverability); the others are disposable-email APIs.

emailFallbacks.title: Email fallback backends
emailFallbacks.description: Comma-separated backends tried in order when the primary one fails (e.g. mail.cx 402 over quota, bad Gmail app password, inbox allocation error). Allowed: mailcx, boomlify, tmaily, gmail, procmail, mailtm.

mailcxApiToken.title: mail.cx API token
mailcxApiToken.description: API token for api.mail.cx (mail.cx dashboard -> Tokens). Required for the 'mailcx' backend.

mailcxDomain.title: mail.cx domain
mailcxDomain.description: Domain to mint mail.cx addresses on (must be one of mail.cx's system domains). Leave empty to use mail.cx's default domain.

boomlifyApiKey.title: Boomlify API key
boomlifyApiKey.description: Optional. Leave empty to use Boomlify's free web inbox. If set, the 'boomlify' backend uses the paid API instead (each inbox costs credits).

boomlifyEmailTime.title: Boomlify inbox lifetime
boomlifyEmailTime.description: API mode only: how long the Boomlify address lives (free web inboxes last ~2 months). Must outlast the email wait (up to 45 min), so 10min is too short.

boomlifyDomains.title: Boomlify preferred domains
boomlifyDomains.description: Comma-separated Boomlify domains to use first, in order. IPTVV rejects some Boomlify domains as disposable; beta.pendulum.cyou is known to pass. If none is available, a random non-blocked domain is used.

boomlifyBlockedDomains.title: Boomlify blocked domains
boomlifyBlockedDomains.description: Comma-separated Boomlify domains IPTVV rejects as disposable; never used. Domains rejected during a run are skipped automatically for the rest of that run.

tmailyDomain.title: tmaily domain
tmailyDomain.description: Domain to mint tmaily.com addresses on (must be one of tmaily's active domains). Leave empty to let tmaily pick a random domain.

gmailAddress.title: Gmail address
gmailAddress.description: Base Gmail address for the 'gmail' backend; each run checks out with a unique plus-addressed alias of it.

gmailAppPassword.title: Gmail app password
gmailAppPassword.description: Google app password for the Gmail address (Google Account → Security → 2-Step Verification → App passwords). Required for the 'gmail' backend; used for IMAP polling only.

emailMaxWaitSeconds.title: Max email wait (seconds)
emailMaxWaitSeconds.description: How long to poll the inbox for the credentials email before timing out.

cloudflareWaitSeconds.title: Cloudflare wait (seconds)
cloudflareWaitSeconds.description: How long to wait for the checkout form past a Cloudflare/WAF interstitial.

iboPlayerEnabled.title: Save to IBO Player
iboPlayerEnabled.description: If enabled, the extracted credentials are pushed to IBO Player via its API.

iboPlayerCookie.title: IBO Player cookie (legacy)
iboPlayerCookie.description: Legacy Cookie header value for iboplayer.com. No longer used for auth; the actor now logs in via MAC + device key below.

iboPlayerMacAddress.title: IBO Player device MAC address
iboPlayerMacAddress.description: Device MAC (e.g. b8:13:a0:e0:6e:83) used to log in and obtain a bearer token (required when IBO Player is enabled).

iboPlayerDeviceKey.title: IBO Player device key
iboPlayerDeviceKey.description: Device key/PIN used with the MAC to log in to iboplayer.com (required when IBO Player is enabled).

iboPlayerPlaylistUrlId.title: IBO Player playlist URL ID
iboPlayerPlaylistUrlId.description: current_playlist_url_id for the IBO Player savePlaylist call.

iboPlayerPlaylistName.title: IBO Player playlist name
iboPlayerPlaylistName.description: Display name for the saved playlist.

m3uUrl.title: M3U URL (GitHub update only)
m3uUrl.description: If set, the actor skips the trial automation and only pushes this M3U URL to the GitHub secret and triggers the workflow (needs the GitHub token below).

githubEnabled.title: Update GitHub playlist
githubEnabled.description: If enabled, the M3U URL is stored in a GitHub Actions secret and the playlist-updater workflow is triggered.

githubToken.title: GitHub token
githubToken.description: GitHub token with Secrets (write) and Actions (write) access to the playlist repo. Required when GitHub update is enabled.

githubSecretName.title: GitHub secret name
githubSecretName.description: Actions secret that receives the M3U URL.

githubWorkflow.title: GitHub workflow file
githubWorkflow.description: Workflow file (or ID) dispatched after the secret is updated.

githubRef.title: GitHub workflow ref
githubRef.description: Branch the workflow is dispatched on.
